fields.statement: Verifier at d93f1b12: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/workflow -run TestShipChangeCIFixPrompt passes; it asserts the ship-change ci-fix prompt carries reproduce-locally (repeat until it fails again or plainly passes, never push to see), fix or quarantine with a bug request filed and named at the skip, and commit only once the tests and touched packages pass locally, and that it names no go test/go vet/make/testscript/TestScripts/-trimpath. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestShipCheckRerunBudget|TestWatchdogCIRerun' passes (3 reruns ok; one earlier run tripped rootguard on a concurrent write to the enclosing root's state folder with every test PASS, not reproduced). TestWatchdogCIRerun pins one rerun at ciReruns 1; new TestWatchdogCIRerunBudgetN shows reruns exactly while attempt <= N for N=1..3 and none above; TestShipCheckRerunBudget shows --reruns 2 reruns twice then settles red, resetting on a new head (TestShipCheckRerunDefaultOnce, also passing, pins the default of 1). Diff read: prompt change in internal/workflow/builtin/ship-change.toml plus the two tests and the builder's actor record.
